dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); uses GnuCOBOL with ORCA-specific COPY books (CPKENSASORTWK.INC, CPKENSASORT.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, MCPAREA, MCPDATA.INC, CPMUPLINK.INC, CPORCSNUM.INC, COMMON-SPA) and MCP database interface pattern

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - inspection/examination classification master (kensasort) update processing
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that processes updates to the examination/inspection classification master table (tbl_kensasort). It reads an input file of change records and performs INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE operations on the database via the MCP interface, writing errors to an error file and a proof/log file.

notable_features: MCP database interface (DBSELECT, DBINSERT, DBCLOSECURSOR via PERFORM 900-ORCDBMAIN-SEC)
LINKAGE SECTION with LNK-AREA (called as subprogram)
STRING verb for dynamic file path construction
Multiple COPY books with REPLACING clause
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS)
grpsys label prefix on certain lines
verdict.notes: File contains Japanese text encoded in a Japanese encoding (likely EUC-JP) decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in comments. The program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently.
